title: Create the dynamic 13-week cash and revolver model
prompt:
Create this file:
`Deliverables/Q3 dynamic 13-week cash and revolver - 7.6.xlsx`

Begin with the July liquidity, banking, and covenant-outlook thread in `Requests/`, including the bank follow-up. Use the current controller-tied workpapers and operating extracts, keeping earlier versions only for comparison. Resolve conflicts using dates, approvals, document status, and management correspondence. Reconcile posted Alder Ridge balances through the contractor-accounting MCP; keep external targets, peer data, bank terms, and market evidence tied to their controlling finance sources.

Create `Opening Position`, `Receipts`, `Disbursements`, `Weekly Forecast`, `Debt and Interest`, and `Checks`. Roll all thirteen weeks from posted unrestricted cash. Calculate interest and unused fees on beginning weekly revolver balances before determining each draw or repayment, and draw only to the operating floor. Include minimum pre-financing cash, first draw week, maximum ending revolver balance, ending debt and cash, total interest and unused fees, remaining commitment at peak debt, cash-rollforward, debt-feedback, floor, commitment, and source controls.

Also haircut receipts by confidence and cap weekly draws at collateral-derived availability; expose floor breaches and unfunded liquidity.

Document the controlling sources in the deliverable, recalculate or render the finished file as appropriate, and save it to the exact target path.

Keep the shared company workspace clean: change only the requested target file and do not leave behind draft scripts or temporary exports. Open and recalculate the exact saved target before finishing, and verify that it contains no spreadsheet error values.
